314: Option<std::vector<Index>> SearchEngine::search_phrase(std::string_view query) const {
315:     const std::vector<std::string> words = tokenize(query);
316:     if (words.empty()) {
317:         return std::nullopt;
318:     }
319: 
320:     const auto first_word = inverted_index.find(words.front());
321:     if (first_word == inverted_index.end()) {
322:         return std::nullopt;
323:     }
324: 
325:     std::vector<Index> matches;
326:     for (const Index& start : first_word->second) {
327:         std::vector<Index> phrase_match{start};
328:         bool is_phrase = true;
329: 
330:         for (size_t offset = 1; offset < words.size(); ++offset) {
331:             const auto found = inverted_index.find(words[offset]);
332:             if (found == inverted_index.end()) {
333:                 return std::nullopt;
334:             }
335: 
336:             const auto next = std::ranges::find_if(found->second, [&](const Index& index) {
337:                 return index.book_id == start.book_id && index.chapter_id == start.chapter_id &&
338:                        index.line == start.line && index.word_idx == start.word_idx + offset;
339:             });
340: 
341:             if (next == found->second.end()) {
342:                 is_phrase = false;
343:                 break;
344:             }
345: 
346:             phrase_match.push_back(*next);
347:         }
348: 
349:         if (is_phrase) {
350:             matches.insert(matches.end(), phrase_match.begin(), phrase_match.end());
351:         }
352:     }
353: 
354:     if (matches.empty()) {
355:         return std::nullopt;
356:     }
357: 
358:     std::ranges::sort(matches, {}, cmpr);
359:     return matches;
